title: Why Ganga Married King Shantanu on One Condition
description: King Shantanu made a fatal bargain for the love of a celestial river goddess, promising never to question her actions no matter how cruel they seemed. But when she began drowning their newborns one by one, the agonizing silence finally broke, revealing a shocking divine truth.
